catalog.name: Energy Production
catalog.description:
This collection contains the wind energy production maps expressed in MWh/MW calculated as an annual average over 30 years of data at different heights.
In particular, these elaborations derive from the new Italian anemological database consisting of 30 years of data with an hourly and spatial time step of 1.4 km, using the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) meteorological model combined with a post-processing statistic based on Analog Ensemble (AnEn).

members.name: Onshore Energy Production
members.description: This collection includes onshore wind energy production maps (MWh/MW) at heights of 50, 75 and 100 m above ground level.

members.name: Specific onshore energy production at 50 m a.g.l.
members.description:
Specific onshore producibility at 50 m above ground level expressed in MWh/MW.
A Riva Calzoni ATB 500.54 wind turbine with a rotor diameter of 54 m and a nominal power of 500 kW has been used to calculate the producibility.

members.name: Specific onshore energy production at 75 m a.g.l.
members.description:
Specific onshore energy production at 75 m above ground level expressed in MWh/MW.
The map shows for each cell the maximum energy production value among those obtained using the following wind turbines: Leitwind LTW [nominal power: 2 MW], Enercon E92 [nominal power: 2.3 MW], Vestas V90 [nominal power: 2MW] e Vestas V110 [nominal power: 2MW].
